title: Finding your way around the organisation

steps.say: This column is the map, and it never goes away. Read down it for the path from your top level to the one you are standing on.
Under your own level sit its neighbours and everything hanging beneath it, so you can always tell how deep into the organisation you have gone.

Tap any name to move straight there. The page rebuilds around the new level and the map redraws with it. A leader only ever sees their own part of the organisation — the map is trimmed by the server, not hidden in the page.
steps.terminal: That's the map — one column that always answers where you are. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
